about: Screencast camera + transitions measured with ONE frame pipeline on Jake's tutorials (2026-10-07): ref 2 kwysV2smgfY, ref 3 3Jq-L6uLd28, ref 4 Geg9TyNoi3w, ref 5 AZxFgIVgHjg (all 1080p 29.97). Pipeline: /opt/aieditor-work/reference/work/sc5/bin (pass1.py = one container, cv2 decode, ECC affine per consecutive 320x180 frame, bubble masked; analyze.py = spans/transitions/moves + free cubic-bezier fits; summary.py). Moves = runs of camera motion >= 15 f with fit rms < 0.006 (scroll flicks <= 8 f excluded). Dissolves = full-frame (>= 50 % of cells change) blends with a spatially uniform weight, >= 3 f. Frame numbers are 0-based at 30000/1001.
